svg.title: The card as Komorebi runs it
svg.text: 120 Tensix cores, four X280 clusters, eight DRAM banks
loads the program, submits commands, waits for events
host or X280 thread to a core group
a message forwarded to the core it names
parts into a fixed slot of rank 0, added there
a block or a word along a row or a column
tell, ask and pull between a core and its X280 core
both data-movement CPUs on one stream from DRAM
code loaded from DRAM into a slot of a core's L1
tensor pages between cores and the host's memory, by PCIe
commands, pages and messages to another card, by Ethernet
commands from the host and three rings
streams, graphs and a job queue
64 commands in flight, a deadline each
overlays, in slots of its L1
a C thread on four cores (kmx_main)
answers its cores' tells, asks and pulls
Tensix core, with its core index
a command's group, cores 24 to 35; core 24 leads it
a cluster's regions, in the bank beside it
fused off, or a router only
a ring: commands to X280 0, events back
Measured: 0.77 µs a command with 4 in flight to all 120 cores (the landing experiment). Columns 7 and 10 are the
Tensix columns fused off on the card used here. The leader acknowledges its command to X280 0 on NoC1.
A thread reaches the other banks with kmx_fetch, and another card's cores over the links: each has a figure of its own below.
